# StartPage

**Class:** `UltraCanvasStartPage` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasStartPage.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasStartPage.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasStartPage.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

The page an application shows with nothing open yet - title, why this page, the entries opened last as buttons, the open action, a section of the app's own fields for a new thing, a status line; `PreferredHeight()` sizes the window ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasStartPage.md))

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
explicit UltraCanvasStartPage(const std::string& identifier, int width);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetRecent()` | `void SetRecent(const std::string& heading, const std::vector<std::string>& entries, std::function<void(const std::string&)> onPick, int shown = 5)` | The entries opened last, the first one first, each a button that shows its last path part and the whole entry (shortened in the middle where it does not fit, so the drive and the last part stay; the whole entry as the tooltip) and calls `onPick` with the entry. At most `shown` of them; nothing is added for an empty … |
| `AddAction()` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasButton> AddAction(const std::string& text, std::function<void()> onClick, const std::string& note = std::string(), bool primary = true)` | The action that opens an existing thing: the primary button, as wide as the column, and a muted note under it when `note` is given. Returns the button. |
| `AddButton()` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasButton> AddButton(const std::string& text, std::function<void()> onClick, int width = 0)` | A button in the current section, `width` wide (0: the column), styled as the secondary action. Returns the button. |

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetTitle` | `void SetTitle(const std::string& text)` | The heading at the top, and the sentence under it that says why this page is showing (up to three lines). |
| `SetHint` | `void SetHint(const std::string& text)` |  |
| `AddSection` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasContainer> AddSection(const std::string& heading, int height = 0)` | A section for the application's own fields: a heading and a container as wide as the content column. With a `height` the application places its fields in it from (0, 0) itself; without one the section grows with the rows the three calls below add to it (the section added last, until the next part is added). |
| `AddField` | `int AddField(const std::string& caption, const std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasUIElement>& input, int captionWidth = 190)` | A row of the current section: `caption` in a label `captionWidth` wide at the left, `input` beside it - as wide as the rest of the column and a row tall unless it has a width of its own, in which case it keeps its size. Returns the row's y in the section. |
| `AddNote` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasLabel> AddNote(const std::string& text, int height = 40)` | A line of text across the current section, `height` tall, muted and wrapping: a note under the fields, or the reason a button is greyed (set its text later). Returns the label. |
| `AddStatusLine` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasLabel> AddStatusLine()` | The status line, placed where it is added - last, as a rule; Say writes it, muted, or in the theme's error colour. |
